description: This source file contains PHP functions for handling JSON responses related to workflow components in vtiger CRM, including fetching module fields, functions, dependent modules, and owner lists.

methods.name: vtJsonFields
methods.description: Fetches fields for a given module name and outputs them in JSON format.

methods.name: vtJsonFunctions
methods.description: Retrieves expression functions and outputs them in JSON format.

methods.name: vtJsonDependentModules
methods.description: Gets dependent modules for a given module and outputs them in JSON format, considering various filters.

methods.name: vtJsonOwnersList
methods.description: Provides a list of active users and groups for owner selection, outputting JSON.
